dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Nihon Igikai standard receipt system), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically inpatient (入院) diagnosis classification point aggregation (診療区分別点数集計)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It processes inpatient medical receipt data files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE69) to aggregate diagnosis/treatment category points for insurance claim submissions. It handles complex Japanese medical insurance billing rules including partial patient co-payments, public expense subsidies, and various special treatment categories.

notable_features: 43 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
86 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram library
486 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Indexed file organization with DYNAMIC access mode
Multiple file descriptors sharing same physical file via ASSIGN
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Long revision history with named developers (NACL team)
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) and appear as latin-1 mojibake in the decoded view. The file is 445KB / 9291 lines indicating a large, complex production program. The // delimiter style in COPY REPLACING is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software maintained by JMA.
